tei:div.tei:p:
“And the Eternal passed by before him (Moses) and proclaimed: The Eternal is the immutable eternal being; an omnipotent God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering and abundant in beneficence and truth; keeping mercy unto thousands, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin, and acquitting. Pardon thou our iniquity and our sin,
and take us for thy heritage. Forgive us, O our Father! for we have sinned: pardon us, O our King! for we have transgressed. For thou, O Lord! art good, and ready to pardon, and of abundant mercy unto all those who call on thee.”
